groups.name: Map and script support
groups.detail: Required asset relocations and shared data for the selected features.

groups.name: Faster FireRed extras
groups.detail: Optional speed and field tweaks; separate from lab start and the forest nurse.

groups.name: Shared Baconmon support
groups.detail: Support for the selected Baconmon features. Gameplay switches are applied independently.

groups.name: Baconmon title screen
groups.detail: Grumpig, Kaizo Baconmon and the FireRed title graphics.

groups.name: Guaranteed hidden items
groups.detail: Remove the chance check from renewable hidden-item spawns.

groups.name: Poison-friendly forest nurse
groups.detail: Allow the Viridian Forest nurse to heal a poisoned party.

groups.name: Baconmon dialogue
groups.detail: The lab e-mail and the other custom dialogue.

groups.name: Level 8 lab rival
groups.detail: Set the three lab rival parties to level 8 without changing their species or moves.

groups.name: Battle status display
groups.detail: Fix missing status icons in the lab rival battle, including paralysis, poison, burn, sleep and freeze.

seed_protection: Existing Pokemon, learnsets, trainer species, encounters and item data are retained except the explicitly listed feature writes.

core_features.name: Classic / Modern
core_features.detail: Choose Classic or Modern in Oak’s lab. Off keeps Gen 3 battle mechanics and removes the mode prompt. Note: Fairy typing is intentionally omitted.

core_features.name: Lab start and early balls
core_features.detail: Choose player details, start ready in Oak’s lab, and receive the early Master Ball and five Poké Balls. Off uses the original opening and bedroom start.

core_features.name: Early encounter rotation
core_features.detail: Use the Ironmon VS early encounter rotation.

core_features.name: Field HMs and Town Map Fly
core_features.detail: Use HMs without teaching them, with the usual HM, badge and story prerequisites. Fly from the Town Map.

core_features.name: Friendship machine and helpers
core_features.detail: Use the lab machine to raise or lower friendship. Helpers point to the machine. Off disables the added friendship services.

core_features.name: Nuz-guide and score log
core_features.detail: Give the guide key item and record progress, dungeon visits and full heals. Off installs neither the item nor its monitoring hooks.

core_features.name: Battle move descriptions and category icons
core_features.detail: Press L at move selection for descriptions, and show move categories on the summary screen.

core_features.name: Fuchsia move relearner
core_features.detail: Add the TM-paid relearner opposite the move deleter. Off leaves the original house and Two Island tutor arrangement.
